groups.activity: Xaku or Limbo box-breaking (Hepit Capture, Teshub Exterminate), or Void Survival with a loot frame
conditions: Argon Crystals stay safe until the first 00:00 UTC reset at least 24 hours after pickup, then the stack halves at every later reset; farm it last and start the build the same day.
bonuses: Max-range Xaku (The Vast Untime) or Limbo (Cataclysm) on Hepit (Capture) or Teshub (Exterminate) breaks containers and Argon Pegmatite deposits through walls; both now show on the minimap.
Void Survival (Mot or Ani) with Nekros, Khora or Hydroid works too; Corrupted Vor in Mot drops an Argon Crystal about 50% of the time, not guaranteed as Reddit often claims.
Resource Booster, Drop Chance Booster, a relay Drop Chance Blessing, Resourceful Retriever and Smeeta Kavat's Charm all apply to Argon.
